## History

Tommy is a classmate in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who attends school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). During class, he witnesses the conflict between [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), which leads to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) breaking her slate over Gilbert's head. Later, he is mentioned among the local children whom [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) leaves [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing and playing with, directly defying Mrs. Lynde's orders.

## Relationships

### [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/mirabel-cotton--tommy.md)

Tommy and [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) are brother and sister. They spent time playing and fishing with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) after [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) dragged his sister away from [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) against Mrs. Lynde's orders.
